description: This is a PHP class file for the 'Article' controller in the OpenCart administration panel. The class handles actions related to managing CMS articles, including listing articles, displaying forms for editing or adding articles, and processing CRUD operations. It incorporates functionalities for pagination, sorting, filtering, and managing related data such as authors, topics, stores, and descriptions.
